about: MR60BHA2 bridge recordings for the vitals pipeline (host-java/marvin-contracts/tools/mr60_recordings.py). Host times in seconds from the start of the recording; expectations checked by VitalsRecordingsTest.

scenarios.name: mr60_desk
scenarios.description: The MR60BHA2 bridge on its own on a desk (no presence radar): nobody (0-5 s), someone sits at 85 cm (rates from 8 s, valid and steady), fidgets (50-56 s: valid, not steady, the heart rate jumps), still again, leaves (80 s).

scenarios.name: mr60_with_robot
scenarios.description: The simulated robot (LD2450 and simulated VITALS, seated in its scene from 26 s) and, from 10 s, the MR60BHA2 bridge on the desk with other rates: one seat, one radar. The bridge, real, takes the seat from the simulated radar at once; the robot's LD2450 still says whether the person is still.
